scope: Read-only schema review. EPIT/Soccol feature coverage uses existing full input tables; MPEA coverage and formulation decisions use only its frozen development rows. No target column parsed. No dataset, split, formula or model changed.
implementation_notes: Existing native EPIT/Soccol schemas are 28/37 features; current combined schema has 50.
Shared named-column mapping already enforces feature identity and order; it does not infer unit conversions.
Old Soccol specialist preprocessing zero-fills ion blanks. The current shared export preserves remaining blanks; do not label all Soccol ion zeros as imputed.
New categorical labels require consistent meaning/encoding in all three sources, synthetic data and real evaluation.
Preserve frozen row/fold assignments. Any changed feature exports require separately versioned artifacts with the same row memberships and explicit new hashes.
The new combined training must generate the added features with meaningful joint relationships; adding them only at inference is insufficient.
